err_desktop_source_not_found_macos: Desktop audio source was not found on macOS. Use a virtual loopback device (for example, BlackHole/Soundflower/Loopback).
err_list_desktop_sources_failed: Failed to list desktop audio sources: {error}
err_loopback_not_found: Desktop audio source was not found.
err_no_output_device: No output device found for desktop recording.
err_no_output_device_id: Output device does not provide an ID for loopback.
tooltip_auto_transcribe: When enabled, transcription starts automatically right after recording stops.
tooltip_speaker_mic: Label used for speech recognized from the microphone track (for example, "Me" or a speaker name).
tooltip_speaker_desktop: Label used for speech recognized from the desktop track (remote speaker, call, video, etc.).
tooltip_library: Transcription engine selection. Different libraries trade off speed, quality, and system requirements.
tooltip_transcription_mode: local processes recordings on this computer; network uploads audio to the configured Whisper server and downloads text.
tooltip_network_url: Home Whisper server address, for example http://192.168.1.10:8765.
tooltip_model: Recognition model size/type. Larger models are usually more accurate but slower.
tooltip_device: Where transcription runs: CPU or GPU (if available). GPU is usually faster.
tooltip_compute: Computation precision for faster-whisper. Lower precision can speed up processing and reduce memory use.
tooltip_vad_filter: Enables stricter post-filtering for low-energy fragments. Base loudness-based speech interval detection is always applied.
tooltip_include_timestamps: Adds time markers to text segments in the output .txt file.
tooltip_transcribe_mix_track: Runs an additional transcription pass on mix.ogg and saves mix_transcript.txt. This increases processing time.
tooltip_language: Speech language for recognition. Auto mode detects language once per session.
tooltip_beam: Search quality parameter. Higher beam can improve quality but slows processing.
log_transcription_started: Transcription started: {session_dir} | lib={library}, model={model}, device={device}, lang={lang}, beam={beam}, vad={vad}, compute={compute}
log_window_close_cancel: Window is closing: transcription cancellation requested
network_status_uploading: Uploading recording to the Whisper server...
network_status_downloading: Downloading text from the Whisper server...
msg_delete_recordings_confirm:
Delete selected recordings ({count})?

This action cannot be undone.
msg_select_recording_from_list: Select a recording from the list.
msg_session_missing_tracks: Selected session is missing mic.ogg and desktop.ogg tracks.
msg_wait_transcription_complete: Wait for the current transcription to complete first.
transcriber_err_compute_types: Failed to determine supported compute devices.
transcriber_err_gpu_torch_cpu_only: GPU mode is selected, but the installed PyTorch build has no CUDA support. Reinstall torch with a CUDA wheel or switch device to CPU/auto.
transcriber_err_gpu_unavailable: GPU mode is selected but no CUDA device is available.
transcriber_err_missing_tracks: Selected folder does not contain both tracks (mic.ogg and desktop.ogg).
